summary: The candidate is mathematically correct and complete. The midpoint argument establishes the required coupled orbit downsets and binary roots without assuming product support. The endpoint indexing is injective, its simultaneous swap involution gives disjoint antipodal pairs, and the ambient halfspace argument yields the stated root depths with the original probabilities. Both Holder steps and the factorial identity have the stated exponents and normalizations. Enlarging the nonnegative coupled sum to the full Cartesian index set is valid, and the scalar sums match accepted fact 803f398e39c669b9 exactly after setting its spatial dimension to each block size and its cutoff to the maximal admissible value. The reflected conditional profiles, their normalizers, and the bijection of nonzero-normal ambient halfspaces are explicit and correct. The disjoint-sector comparison contributes the fourth powers of sector masses and the factor 8^{-G}, giving exactly the claimed coefficient. Singleton supports, blocks of size one, missing ranks, strict sector boundaries, empty sectors, and lower-dimensional or nonclosed convex supports introduce no exception. No counterexample or proof gap was found.
